name: Cyber Mastiff

abilities.name: Go For the Throat!
abilities.text: The Cyber Mastiff Charges at the nearest target and uses it's Plasteel Bite. If it deals one or more Wounds, the target suffers the Bleeding and Prone Conditions.

determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (5 Wounds, between Troop and Adversary). Beside homebrew apoc-cyber-mastiff (named Cyber-Mastiff there). Plasteel Bite prints no range; stored [1].
